# Parameters
p <- 0.70  # target proportion
z_critical <- qnorm(0.975)  # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile for two-sided 95% CI
e <- 0.03  # half-width (margin of error)

# Verify z-critical value matches specification
cat("Z-critical (qnorm(0.975)):", z_critical, "\n")
cat("Expected z-critical (1.96):", 1.96, "\n\n")

# Sample size formula for proportion estimation:
# n = (z²/e²) × p(1-p)
n_exact <- (z_critical^2 / e^2) * p * (1 - p)

cat("Exact sample size calculation:\n")
cat("n = (z²/e²) × p(1-p)\n")
cat("n = (", z_critical, "²/", e, "²) ×", p, "×", (1-p), "\n")
cat("n = (", z_critical^2, "/", e^2, ") × ", p*(1-p), "\n")
cat("n = ", z_critical^2/e^2, " × ", p*(1-p), "\n")
cat("n = ", n_exact, "\n\n")

# Round upward to nearest integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

cat("Rounded upward (ceiling):\n")
cat("n = ", n_rounded, " participants\n\n")

# Verification: Check achieved CI half-width at n_rounded
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1-p) / n_rounded)
achieved_half_width <- z_critical * achieved_se

cat("Verification at n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Standard error = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) = sqrt(", p*(1-p), "/", n_rounded, ") =", achieved_se, "\n")
cat("Achieved CI half-width = z × SE =", z_critical, "×", achieved_se, "=", achieved_half_width, "\n")
cat("Target half-width = 0.03\n")
cat("Achieved <= Target?", achieved_half_width <= 0.03, "\n\n")

# Output for structured reporting
results <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# Independent verification using standard formulas and alternative implementation
# Study design: Estimate a proportion p = 0.70 with 95% CI, half-width e = 0.03

# Parameters from specification
p <- 0.70
confidence_level <- 0.95
alpha <- 1 - confidence_level  # two-sided: 0.05
half_width <- 0.03

# Critical value: exact standard normal 97.5th percentile
# For two-sided 95% CI, we use alpha/2 = 0.025 in upper tail
z_crit <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n\n")
cat("Specification Check:\n")
cat("  Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("  Confidence level:", confidence_level, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha, two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Tail for critical value: 1 - alpha/2 =", 1 - alpha/2, "\n")
cat("  Standard normal 97.5th percentile:", z_crit, "\n")
cat("  Half-width (margin of error):", half_width, "\n\n")

# Standard sample size formula for proportion CI:
# The confidence interval for p is: p_hat ± z * sqrt(p(1-p)/n)
# where the half-width is: e = z * sqrt(p(1-p)/n)
# Solving for n: n = (z^2 / e^2) * p(1-p)

n_continuous <- (z_crit^2 / half_width^2) * p * (1 - p)

cat("Sample Size Calculation:\n")
cat("  Formula: n = (z²/e²) × p(1-p)\n")
cat("  z² =", z_crit^2, "\n")
cat("  e² =", half_width^2, "\n")
cat("  z²/e² =", z_crit^2 / half_width^2, "\n")
cat("  p(1-p) =", p * (1 - p), "\n")
cat("  n (continuous) =", n_continuous, "\n\n")

# Rounding upward (ceiling)
n_final <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("Rounding Convention: upward (ceiling)\n")
cat("  n (final) =", n_final, "\n\n")

# Verification: Check that n_final meets the precision target
se_achieved <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_final)
half_width_achieved <- z_crit * se_achieved

cat("=== VERIFICATION AT n =", n_final, "===\n")
cat("  SE = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) =", se_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Achieved half-width = z × SE =", half_width_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Target half-width =", half_width, "\n")
cat("  Achieved ≤ Target?", half_width_achieved <= half_width, "\n\n")

# Check the preceding admissible design (n-1)
n_prev <- n_final - 1
se_prev <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_prev)
half_width_prev <- z_crit * se_prev

cat("=== CHECK PRECEDING DESIGN (n =", n_prev, ") ===\n")
cat("  SE = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) =", se_prev, "\n")
cat("  Half-width = z × SE =", half_width_prev, "\n")
cat("  Achieves target (≤ 0.03)?", half_width_prev <= half_width, "\n\n")

# Numerical precision check
cat("=== NUMERICAL PRECISION ===\n")
cat("  Difference from continuous: n - n_continuous =", n_final - n_continuous, "\n")
cat("  Half-width margin: target - achieved =", half_width - half_width_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Margin as % of target:", round(100 * (half_width - half_width_achieved) / half_width, 4), "%\n\n")

# Final output
cat("=== FINAL RESULT ===\n")
cat("Sample size required: n =", n_final, "participants\n")
cat("Method: Normal approximation to binomial proportion CI\n")
cat("Rounding: ceiling to nearest integer\n")

# Structured output
results <- list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_final, unit = "participants_total"),
  list(metric = "achieved_half_width", value = round(half_width_achieved, 7), unit = "proportion"),
  list(metric = "target_half_width", value = half_width, unit = "proportion"),
  list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 4), unit = "participants")
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

record.fullCode:
# Evidence e1; success=true

# Parameters
p <- 0.70  # target proportion
z_critical <- qnorm(0.975)  # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile for two-sided 95% CI
e <- 0.03  # half-width (margin of error)

# Verify z-critical value matches specification
cat("Z-critical (qnorm(0.975)):", z_critical, "\n")
cat("Expected z-critical (1.96):", 1.96, "\n\n")

# Sample size formula for proportion estimation:
# n = (z²/e²) × p(1-p)
n_exact <- (z_critical^2 / e^2) * p * (1 - p)

cat("Exact sample size calculation:\n")
cat("n = (z²/e²) × p(1-p)\n")
cat("n = (", z_critical, "²/", e, "²) ×", p, "×", (1-p), "\n")
cat("n = (", z_critical^2, "/", e^2, ") × ", p*(1-p), "\n")
cat("n = ", z_critical^2/e^2, " × ", p*(1-p), "\n")
cat("n = ", n_exact, "\n\n")

# Round upward to nearest integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

cat("Rounded upward (ceiling):\n")
cat("n = ", n_rounded, " participants\n\n")

# Verification: Check achieved CI half-width at n_rounded
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1-p) / n_rounded)
achieved_half_width <- z_critical * achieved_se

cat("Verification at n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Standard error = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) = sqrt(", p*(1-p), "/", n_rounded, ") =", achieved_se, "\n")
cat("Achieved CI half-width = z × SE =", z_critical, "×", achieved_se, "=", achieved_half_width, "\n")
cat("Target half-width = 0.03\n")
cat("Achieved <= Target?", achieved_half_width <= 0.03, "\n\n")

# Output for structured reporting
results <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")
